title: Oxidative Stress Protocol
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r69d9h6

steps.title: Dissect and Collect Larvae
steps.instruction: Dissect 10 larvae on ice and place them in 100uL of ice-cold mitochondrial isolation buffer.

steps.title: Homogenize Larvae
steps.instruction: Homogenize the larvae using sterile kontes pellet pestles.

steps.title: Filter Homogenate
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through a gauze pad into a clean 1.5mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipette homogenate into a syringe containing 2cm2 of gauze pad.
Gently press the mixture through the gauze.

steps.title: Isolate Mitochondrial Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and wash the filtered homogenate to isolate the mitochondrial pellet.

substeps.instruction: Wash the resulting brown grey pellet with 200uL of isolation buffer 1 to 2 times to remove lipid.

steps.title: Resuspend Mitochondria
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final mitochondrial pellet in 20uL of mitochondrial isolation buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Respiration Assay
steps.instruction: Prepare the mitochondria in a 96 well plate with respiration buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 5uL of mitochondria solution into 180uL respiration buffer.

steps.title: Add Fluorescent Probe and Peroxide
steps.instruction: Add Ampliflu Red and horseradish peroxide to the well.

substeps.instruction: Add 5uL of 2.20mM ampliflu red (55uM final conc).
Add 10uL of 0.02U/uL (20U/mL) horseradish peroxide (1U mL-1 final conc).

steps.title: Initiate Reaction and Add Substrates
steps.instruction: Initiate the reaction and add substrates sequentially, allowing for a stabilization period between each addition.
